title: Raycast developers grid
description: A blueprint-style three-column hairline grid on a near-black page, with faint rules running past it: an intro cell (a 56px light-weight title, a hairline, a mono paragraph and a bold mono link), six dotted figure cells labelled FIG_01…06 holding artwork slots, and four text cells (title, mono blurb, a small arrow top-right) placed between them in a zig-zag. One column on phones. Hover nudges the arrows.
notes: the figures are media slots (a faint panel over a dotted floor when empty)
uses the theme's mono face for body text
